title: fedlin.pqc-context 1.1
description: Business context for a scan: systems, owners, FIPS 199 impact, data confidentiality lifetime and migration time. Orders attention and flags harvest-now-decrypt-later urgency; never changes a verdict or priority.

horizon.description: Planning horizon year for the urgency flag, for every system. When absent: 2030 for a system of high impact or marked highValueAsset (NIST IR 8547 and OMB M-26-15), else 2035 (NIST IR 8547 disallows quantum-vulnerable public-key algorithms after 2035). A policy date, not a forecast.

dataLifetimeYears.description: How long data protected by this system must stay confidential.

migrationYears.description: How long migrating this system to post-quantum cryptography will take. If absent, the urgency flag uses the data lifetime alone and says so.

endpoints.description: Patterns: host glob (*.pay.example.gov), host:port, or IP network (10.2.0.0/16, 2001:db8::/32).

highValueAsset.description: A high-value asset: its urgency uses the 2030 horizon unless the file sets one. Schema 1.1 only.
